name: cc-crisply
description: Sharper Claude Code replies: framed code, one-click copy, and Mermaid diagrams, right in your terminal.

diagramDisplay.title: Diagram display
diagramDisplay.description: How Mermaid diagrams are shown: auto (pictures in Ghostty, kitty and iTerm2 3.5+ fullscreen, box-drawing text elsewhere), text (box-drawing text everywhere), or code (the Mermaid source). Needs merman-cli.

diagramTheme.title: Diagram theme
diagramTheme.description: The diagrams' colors: auto (follow the Claude Code theme, or the terminal's background for its auto theme), dark, or light.

promptBorder.title: Prompt border
promptBorder.description: Draw your prompts in the transcript inside a border, on their own background.
